stories.title: Formel 1 in Malaysia: Max Verstappen auf der Pole, Saisonfinale in Abu Dhabi soll stattfinden

en.title: Formula 1 in Malaysia: Max Verstappen on pole, season finale in Abu Dhabi to take place
en.summary: Formula 1 is racing in Malaysia for the first time since 2017, with the Bahrain Grand Prix relocated there due to the Iran conflict. Max Verstappen secured pole position.

stories.title: Formel 1 in Sepang: Verstappen rast zu seiner ersten Pole Position in diesem Jahr

en.title: Formula 1 in Sepang: Verstappen races to his first pole position this year
en.summary: Max Verstappen achieved his first pole position of the season at the Sepang qualifying session, while Nico Hülkenberg faced difficulties.

stories.title: Fall Widdecombe: Möglicherweise auch Anschlag auf Farage geplant

en.title: Widdecombe case: Possible attack on Farage also planned
en.summary: A 28-year-old was charged with murder in connection with the death of Brexit politician Widdecombe in July. Investigators have now linked the case to additional attack plans, including against right-wing populist Farage.

stories.title: Lula vor Wahl in Brasilien: 80 Jahre und noch nicht müde

en.title: Lula before election in Brazil: 80 years old and not tired yet
en.summary: President Lula seeks to win Sunday's Brazilian election against the son of his predecessor Bolsonaro. A victory would mark his fourth term as a former trade union leader and important partner for Europe.

stories.title: Todesstrafe in Tennessee: Neue Details zu gescheiterter Hinrichtung

en.title: Death penalty in Tennessee: New details about failed execution
en.summary: Following a failed execution attempt, death row inmate Christa Pike remains unconscious in a hospital on life support. Court documents from her lawyers have revealed additional details about the incident.

stories.title: US-Medienberichte: Flydubai-Co-Pilot galt zuvor als Sicherheitsrisiko

en.title: US media reports: Flydubai co-pilot previously considered security risk
en.summary: Reports indicate the Flydubai co-pilot was prohibited from flying at a previous employer due to suspected extremism. Emirati authorities are investigating the incident as a potential terrorist act.

stories.title: Straße von Hormus: Unbekannte beschießen Tanker vor Oman

en.title: Strait of Hormuz: Unknown attackers fire on tanker off Oman
en.summary: An oil tanker was hit by gunfire in the strategically important Strait of Hormuz near Oman's northern tip, where vessels have faced repeated attacks recently.

stories.title: Flydubai-Copilot galt bei Oman Air offenbar als Sicherheitsrisiko

en.title: Flydubai co-pilot considered security risk at Oman Air
en.summary: The co-pilot suspected of causing a Flydubai crash had previously been flagged as a security concern and suspended at a former employer. Investigators disclosed the attack was carried out with an axe.

stories.title: Brasilien: Streit über Justizeingriff in TV-Debatte vor Lula-Bolsonaro-Wahl

en.title: Brazil: Dispute over judicial intervention in TV debate before Lula-Bolsonaro election
en.summary: Brazil's judiciary pressured TV broadcaster Globo to cancel the final planned presidential debate shortly before the election. Media organizations criticized the judicial action as an overreach with significant implications for the candidates.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Nahost-Krieg: Bericht: Wieder Angriff auf Tanker in der Straße von Hormus

en.title: Middle East war news blog: Report of another attack on tanker in Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: A vessel on a major shipping route came under fire once again. The incident occurred approximately eight kilometers from the coast.

stories.title: Todesstrafe: Ärzte kämpfen nach gescheiterter Hinrichtung um Pikes Leben

en.title: Capital punishment: Doctors fight for Pike's life after failed execution
en.summary: Christa Pike survived two doses of pentobarbital in Tennessee and remains unconscious on a ventilator. According to her attorneys, the drug reportedly entered tissue rather than veins.

stories.title: Christa Pike – Tennessee: Nach gescheiterter Hinrichtung intubiert und beatmet

en.title: Christa Pike – Tennessee: Intubated and ventilated after failed execution
en.summary: A Tennessee inmate survived an execution by lethal injection and is now receiving medical care in a hospital. Her lawyers have made serious allegations regarding the incident.

stories.title: Sozialreformen: Sozialabgaben-Rechner: So viel mehr müssen Sie 2027 zahlen

en.title: Social reforms: Social contribution calculator: How much more you must pay in 2027
en.summary: Higher earners will face increased social security contributions starting in 2027, with steeper rises above 100,000 euros gross income. A calculator tool shows the anticipated additional payments for different income levels.

stories.title: Kommentar: Die beste Pflegeversicherung sind Sie selbst

en.title: Commentary: The best care insurance is yourself
en.summary: The commentary argues that social reforms typically focus on contribution increases and benefit cuts while overlooking preventive health measures as the most effective approach to controlling rising care costs.

stories.title: +++ Ukraine-Krieg +++: Flughafen Vilnius nach Drohnenalarm geschlossen

en.title: +++ Ukraine War +++: Vilnius Airport closed after drone alarm
en.summary: Vilnius Airport was closed following a drone alert during ongoing Ukraine conflict developments. The news blog reports on Russian military capabilities, EU financial aid to Ukraine, and Ukrainian ceasefire proposals.

en.title: Defense: Bundeswehr IT outage concerns security policymakers
en.summary: Following multiple days of IT disruptions affecting the German armed forces, CDU security policymakers are calling for consequences. Their concerns extend beyond the directly affected reservists.

stories.title: Bezahlsysteme: Mehr als jeder Zweite scheitert beim bargeldlosen Bezahlen

en.title: Payment systems: More than half struggle with cashless payments
en.summary: Many consumers wish to use cards or smartphones for payments more frequently, but some shops and restaurants only accept cash. A finance ministry initiative is receiving support from cooperative banks.
